purpose: Science Owner's Stage-4 integration claim ledger - the exact safe wording, strength, and scope for every major claim area Integration Owner may need when writing UI copy, Research Mode text, or documentation.

claims.exact_safe_wording: IMU provides modest incremental HR-estimation value beyond a capacity-near-matched PPG-only architecture under the tested protocol.
claims.relevant_numeric_result: PPG-DaLiA A_cap->B +0.605 bpm (5/5 seeds); GalaxyPPG participant A_cap->B +0.834 bpm (12/18 favor B)
claims.scope_limitation: Two datasets; GalaxyPPG shows real subject heterogeneity (6/18 disfavor).
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Universal IMU necessity; benefit for every participant/subject.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Safe to present as a positive, externally-replicated, but heterogeneous finding - do not present as uniform.

claims.exact_safe_wording: N/A - this figure must never be cited as current governing evidence.
claims.relevant_numeric_result: Historical ~20.6%/23% relative-MAE-reduction figure used unequal-capacity models (Model A 8,065 params vs Model B 28,865/29,089 params) - HISTORICAL_CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED.
claims.scope_limitation: Never presentable as clean IMU marginal value under any framing.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Any citation of this figure as current, controlled, or governing evidence.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: If this number appears anywhere in older docs/UI copy, replace with the capacity-controlled figures above.

claims.exact_safe_wording: Aligned IMU provides a modest aggregate benefit over the capacity-near-matched PPG baseline and deranged-IMU control in the corrected GalaxyPPG cohort, with meaningful participant heterogeneity.
claims.relevant_numeric_result: Participant A_cap->B +0.834268 bpm (12/18), C->B +0.916231 bpm (13/18); window-level agrees to <0.02 bpm.
claims.scope_limitation: 18 of 24 enrolled (6 excluded for a real data-integrity defect); real subject heterogeneity disclosed.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: 'GalaxyPPG replicates PPG-DaLiA' (use 'qualitatively consistent with'); 24/24 subject cohort; astronaut validation.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Always resolve via ml/stage3_science_resolver.py::resolve_current('galaxyppg_external_replication') - never hard-code the pre-fix invalidated result paths.

claims.exact_safe_wording: Aligned EOG provides bounded same-dataset incremental sleep-staging value beyond EEG-only and shuffled/control conditions under the tested protocol.
claims.scope_limitation: Same-dataset (Sleep-EDF) only; HMC full-cohort external replication pending; bounded n=7 HMC diagnostic did not reproduce the effect (inconclusive at that scale, not a negative external replication).
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: 'EOG is externally replicated' or 'validated on an independent clinical cohort'.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Present as same-dataset evidence with external validity explicitly PENDING, not yet established either way.

claims.exact_safe_wording: No stable evidence of synergy or antagonism between EOG and respiration-derived features for sleep staging under the tested protocol.
claims.scope_limitation: Same-dataset only; interaction estimate itself noisy at n=5 seeds.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Claiming meaningful multi-modal synergy between EOG and respiration.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Do not use this as justification for a joint EOG+Resp architecture decision beyond what each contributes on its own.

claims.exact_safe_wording: A second PPG measurement site did not demonstrate stable aggregate incremental value for HR/PTT estimation under the tested protocol, and the result is fragile to subject exclusion.
claims.relevant_numeric_result: B_minus_A=+1.462 MAE (worse); n=4 held-out test subjects.
claims.scope_limitation: n=4 test subjects; sign-sensitive to exclusion (established in prior sprints).
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Treat as DEPRIORITIZED unless an independent architectural requirement (unrelated to this experiment) justifies it.

claims.exact_safe_wording: Additional leg BioZ did not demonstrate stable aggregate incremental value in the terrestrial body-mass-change proxy experiment and remained heterogeneous/sensitivity-fragile.
claims.relevant_numeric_result: A_minus_B=-0.052 (aggregate disfavors B); 7/10 subjects individually favor B.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: BioZ universally useless; microgravity fluid-shift invalidation.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Present as EXPERIMENTAL/heterogeneous, not as a settled negative.

claims.exact_safe_wording: Under the frozen terrestrial 0-60 mmHg LBNP protocol, thoracic EIS did not show stable aggregate incremental value beyond ECG+pleth, with substantial subject heterogeneity.
claims.relevant_numeric_result: A_minus_B=-0.452 (sign-reverses w/o subject 9); C_minus_B=-1.293 (shrinks substantially w/o subject 9); classification COMPLETE_MIXED.
claims.scope_limitation: n=12; only thoracic site and LBNP-stage target tested; both comparisons subject-9-sensitive.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Universal BioZ uselessness; a stable/uniform negative; microgravity/astronaut fluid-shift disproven; citing the old 607-window HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED_OUT_OF_PROTOCOL result.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Always resolve via ml/stage3_science_resolver.py::resolve_current('lbnp_thoracic_eis') - never the old results/lbnp_thoracic_eis_stage3.json path.

claims.exact_safe_wording: HMC full-cohort access is real and working; a bounded n=7 diagnostic exists but does not establish external EOG replication in either direction.
claims.relevant_numeric_result: Bounded n=7: B_minus_A=-0.031 (2/5 seeds favor B). Current download state: 59 edf present, 58 complete pairs, 52 SHA256-verified, 1 partial (SN060).
claims.scope_limitation: n=7/1-test-recording is far too small to conclude anything about the 151-recording full cohort.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: 'HMC replicates or fails to replicate Sleep-EDF'; promoting the bounded diagnostic to a full-cohort claim.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Mark as LOWER_PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_WORK_PENDING; do not resume HMC download/training from Stage 4.

claims.exact_safe_wording: A bounded n=3 ds003838 diagnostic exists confirming the loader/protocol pipeline works; it does not establish sparse-vs-full-montage EEG architecture value.
claims.scope_limitation: Full ~65-subject cohort requires ~93GB/~9.4h additional download, not attempted.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Using the n=3 diagnostic to select final EEG channel architecture.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Mark as LOWER_PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_WORK_PENDING; do not resume ds003838 download/training from Stage 4.

claims.exact_safe_wording: The Digital Twin is a conceptual, synthetic architecture proposal, not a trained or longitudinally validated personalized model.
governing_evidence: N/A - architectural/design proposal, not a trained-model claim
claims.scope_limitation: No real longitudinal personalization data has been used to train or validate it.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Presenting the Digital Twin as a validated, trained, or longitudinally-tested model.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Any Stage-4 UI/Research-Mode copy about the Digital Twin must retain 'conceptual'/'synthetic'/'not longitudinally validated' framing.

claims.exact_safe_wording: Final sensor architecture selection remains UNRESOLVED; a formal Pareto frontier is NOT_READY.
claims.scope_limitation: This is a decision Emir/Project Coordinator makes, not something Science Owner or Integration Owner pre-decides.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Any Stage-4 artifact declaring a final architecture or a completed Pareto analysis.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Integration Owner may use the decision-input artifacts in this package, but must not mark FINAL_ARCHITECTURE resolved.

claims.exact_safe_wording: A formal Pareto (scientific-value vs. burden) frontier has not been computed - NOT_READY.
claims.scope_limitation: Requires both this science package and Integration Owner's engineering burden analysis, not yet combined.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: Presenting any ranked sensor list as a completed Pareto analysis.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: This package provides the science-side inputs (results/stage4_architecture_decision_inputs_science.json); burden-side inputs are Integration Owner's responsibility.

claims.exact_safe_wording: All current governing evidence is terrestrial (healthy-population or patient-population datasets, or protocol-analog stressors like LBNP for hypovolemia); none constitutes spaceflight or microgravity validation.
claims.scope_limitation: LBNP is a terrestrial protocol-analog for central hypovolemic stress, not a spaceflight or microgravity experiment.
claims.prohibited_stronger_wording: 'This proves microgravity fluid-shift monitoring works/doesn't work'; 'astronaut-validated'; any direct terrestrial-to-spaceflight equivalence claim.
claims.stage4_consumer_guidance: Always distinguish terrestrial experimental evidence, physiological plausibility, and spaceflight validation as three separate tiers - never collapse them into one claim.
